At the heart of Southeast Alaska's vibrant artistic community, the Juneau Artist's Gallery is a collaborative space that celebrates and nurtures the diverse talents of Juneau artists. Founded over 40 years ago, our co-op is a haven for creatives seeking a supportive environment to grow, collaborate, and showcase their work.

…

From wood-turned goods and relief prints to stained glass and jewelry, there's a little bit of something for everyone in this space. Our artists sell a range of many options from framed originals to reprints, offering a little bit of something for everyone across all budgets and tastes. Shipping is available for folks visiting from out of town!

…

Our artists are the heart of our operation! As an artist-run gallery, you're guaranteed to meet one of our 20+ working artists at the front desk running the gallery. The benefit of our cooperative model of operation is that our artists are able to keep 90% of the commissions on each sale! That means lower prices for you and more money directly into their pockets - a win-win across the board!

…

Located on the first floor of the Senate Mall Building in Juneau, Alaska, Juneau Artists Gallery Ltd has been showcasing local artists' work since 1985. Initially operating seasonally, it now provides a year-round space for artists to display their paintings, etchings, photography, jewelry, fabrics, ceramics and more. The gallery is run by a cooperative of local artists and offers a diverse range of affordable artwork.

…

[The 18 best art galleries in Juneau > 3Sealaska Heritage Institute]

Sealaska Heritage Institute, located in downtown Juneau, is a cultural hub showcasing the rich heritage of Tlingit, Haida, and Tsimshian art. The Walter Soboleff Building houses the largest collection of indigenous art in Alaska and features an authentic clan house and contemporary Native artwork. The Arts Campus provides a space for artists to create and display their work, with indoor-outdoor studios and outdoor event spaces for performances and markets.
